newsitem.title: USA: Allied Life forecasts Q4 net share at $0.07-$0.09.
newsitem.headline: Allied Life forecasts Q4 net share at $0.07-$0.09.

text.p: Allied Life Financial Corp said on Thursday it expected its fourth quarter net earnings per share to be between $0.07 and $0.09, after a $1.9 million charge.
The company said in a statement that its fourth quarter and full-year 1996 results will include the special after-tax charge of $1.9 million, or $0.42 per share.
Allied Life said estimated operating earnings per share, excluding the charge, were expected to be in the $0.44 to $0.46 range for the fourth quarter and in the $1.77 to $1.79 range for the year.
"Net income per share, which is reduced by the charge, is expected to be in the $0.07 to $0.09 range for the fourth quarter and in the $1.39 to $1.41 range for the year," the statement said.

The company took the special charge in response to its annual deferred policy acquisition cost study. It suggested refinements in assumptions of future annuity policy persistency and interest spread were necessary.

Allied Life will report its 1996 earnings on or about Feb 10. The company reported earnings of $2.6 million, or $0.48 a share, for the fourth quarter of 1995. It had 1995 earnings of $9.7 million, or $1.78 a share.
